name: Linnworks
description_en:
Linnworks centralizes multichannel listings, orders, inventory and shipping, with warehouse functions and additional modules. Its order workflow uses configurable rules to route work and return shipment tracking to the originating channel.

The relevant selection question is how much coordination a retailer needs across channels and fulfillment routes. Warehouse feature availability also depends on the package and region, so a platform-wide feature list is insufficient for procurement.
description_zh:
Linnworks 集中管理多渠道刊登、订单、库存和运输，并提供仓库功能及附加模块。订单流程使用可配置规则分配作业，并将物流追踪回传原始渠道。

选型重点在于零售商需要协调多少渠道与履约路径。仓库功能还受套餐和地区影响，仅看平台全功能列表不足以采购。

core_features.explanation_en: The order page describes downloads, configurable queues, splitting/merging and FBA/3PL/drop-ship routing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订单页描述自动下载、可配置队列、拆合单及 FBA、3PL、直发路由。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing material lists bins, lots, kits, replenishment, transfers and digital picking/packing, with region-specific capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格资料列出仓位、批次、套装、补货、转移和数字拣配，并注明部分地区限制。

sections.title_en: Route an order and verify tracking return
sections.title_zh: 路由订单并核对追踪回传
sections.en: Connect a representative marketplace and webstore, map SKUs and build explicit routing rules. Follow an imported order into the assigned warehouse, carrier or 3PL, then confirm its tracking reaches the source channel. Include a multi-line split and a bundle so the test covers more than a simple single-item shipment. These are proposed checks, not observed execution.
sections.zh: 连接代表性市场和网店，映射 SKU 并建立明确路由规则。跟踪导入订单到指定仓库、承运商或 3PL，再确认追踪信息回到源渠道。应加入多行拆单和套装，超出单件发货场景。这些为建议检查，尚未实测。

sections.en: The public pricing page marks quality control, 3PL client portals, product substitution and serialization as North America only. Linnworks WMS and SkuVault Enhanced Warehouse are separately named modules. A buyer outside that region should not assume identical capability merely because the corporate homepage displays it. Confirm the actual product, region and entitlement in writing.
sections.zh: 公开价格页将质检、3PL 客户门户、商品替代和序列化标为仅北美。Linnworks WMS 与 SkuVault Enhanced Warehouse 也作为独立模块列出。其他地区不能因为总部主页展示便假设具备相同能力，应书面确认产品、地区与权限。

sections.title_en: Quote monthly order volume and overages
sections.title_zh: 按月订单量及超额取得报价
sections.en: Linnworks publishes a quote-led model based on monthly orders, rather than revenue percentages. Overages apply above the agreed volume; Listing, WMS and SkuVault Enhanced Warehouse are also order-based, while Forecasting is a flat fee. Guided onboarding is included in packages. Numeric subscription amounts and overage rates were not established from the official page.
sections.zh: Linnworks 公布按月订单量询价，而非按营收比例收费，超出约定量会产生超额费用。Listing、WMS、SkuVault Enhanced Warehouse 也按订单量，Forecasting 则为固定费。套餐包含引导上线；官方页未确认具体订阅金额及超额单价。

sections.en: Retailers with several channels and fulfillment destinations can evaluate the rules engine. Test a duplicate import, unavailable carrier, canceled order and partial shipment. Connector breadth and AI suggestions are vendor descriptions; stock synchronization latency, every channel’s retry behavior and a business-specific return workflow remain untested.
sections.zh: 拥有多个渠道和履约目的地的零售商可评估规则引擎。应测试重复导入、承运商不可用、取消订单和部分发货。连接覆盖与 AI 建议属于厂商描述；库存同步延迟、各渠道重试行为和企业特定退货流程未测试。
